PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Library.Name: Predator Tactics
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Library.Description: Predator-themed pursuit, ambush, pack-hunting, positioning, and finishing abilities.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.AmbushRush.Name: Ambush Rush
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.AmbushRush.Desc: Requirements The creature is hidden or undetected by the target. The creature Strides up to twice its Speed, then makes a melee Strike against the target. The target is off-guard against this Strike.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.DragDown.Name: Drag Down
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.DragDown.Descri: The creature makes a melee Strike. If it hits and deals damage, it can then attempt an Athletics check to Trip the same target without needing a free hand. The Strike and Trip both count toward the creature's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty does not increase until after this activity is complete.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.Hamstring.Name: Hamstring
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.Hamstring.Descr: The creature makes a melee Strike aimed at a leg, wing, or other means of locomotion. On a hit, the target takes a 10-foot penalty to its Speed until the end of its next turn.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.BloodScent.Name: Blood Scent
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.BloodScent.Desc: The creature has imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet, but only for living creatures that are below their maximum Hit Points. It can also use this sense to Seek injured prey or follow its trail.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.WoundedQuarry.D: The creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against creatures at or below half their maximum Hit Points.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.CirclingPredato: The creature Steps up to 10 feet. This movement counts as a Step for the purpose of reactions. If it ends this movement flanking an enemy, it gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against that enemy until the start of its next turn.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.IsolationHunter: A creature is isolated while none of its allies are within 10 feet of it. Isolated creatures are off-guard to this creature's melee Strikes.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.PackCollapse.De: Requirements The creature and at least one ally can both reach the same enemy with a melee attack. The creature Strides up to half its Speed, then makes a melee Strike against that enemy. If the Strike hits while the creature and its ally are flanking the target, the target is off-guard to all attacks until the start of the creature's next turn.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.FlankAndFade.De: Trigger An ally hits an enemy that the creature and that ally are flanking. The creature Steps up to 10 feet. This movement counts as a Step for the purpose of reactions.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.RelentlessPursu: Trigger An enemy within 30 feet that the creature can see finishes a move action and is farther from the creature afterward than it was before. Effect After the triggering movement is fully resolved, the creature Strides up to half its Speed toward that enemy. It must end this movement closer to the enemy than it began. This movement triggers reactions normally.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.CorneredFury.De: Trigger An adjacent enemy begins a move action that would cause it to leave its space. The creature makes a melee Strike against the triggering enemy before that enemy leaves its space. Cornered Fury can't be triggered by Step or other movement that doesn't trigger reactions based on movement.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.LatchingBite.De: The creature makes a melee Strike against a creature within reach. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the creature attempts an Athletics check against the same target's Fortitude DC. On a success, the target is grabbed until the end of the creature's next turn unless it Escapes first; on a critical success, it is restrained for the same duration instead. The Strike and Athletics check both count toward the creature's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until both rolls are complete.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.RakeTheFallen.D: Frequency once per round. Requirement Any prone creature is within melee reach. The creature makes a melee Strike against that prone target. On a hit, the Strike deals 2 additional damage per damage die of the Strike. Rake the Fallen is used on the creature's own turn; it is not triggered when an enemy falls prone or Stands.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.CullTheWeak.Des: The creature gains a +2 circumstance bonus to damage rolls with melee Strikes against targets that are frightened, grabbed, prone, restrained, or sickened. A target grants this bonus only once per Strike even if it has more than one of these conditions.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.SuddenBurst.Des: Frequency once per encounter. On its turn, the creature Strides up to half its Speed as a free action. It can use Sudden Burst before or after another action, but not in the middle of resolving another action or activity. This movement triggers reactions normally.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.StalkersPatienc: If the creature is using Avoid Notice when an encounter begins and rolls Stealth for initiative, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to that Stealth check. It doesn't gain this bonus if it rolls initiative with another skill or Perception.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.ShadowTheQuarry: Requirement The creature is hidden or undetected from the triggering enemy. Trigger An enemy within 60 feet that the creature can see finishes a move action. Effect After the enemy's movement is fully resolved, the creature immediately Sneaks up to half its Speed. It must end the movement closer to the triggering enemy and in a space where it has cover or concealment from that enemy. Resolve the Stealth check and the effects of Sneak normally. If there is no legal destination, the creature can't use Shadow the Quarry.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.TerritorialChal: The creature issues a threatening cry, posture, or display. One creature within 30 feet that can perceive the threat attempts a Will save against the hunter's high creature DC. On a failure, the target becomes frightened 1.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.HerdThePrey.Des: Creatures in a 15-foot cone attempt a Reflex save against the hunter's high creature DC. Critical Success The creature is unaffected. Success The creature is pushed 5 feet directly away from the hunter. Failure The creature is pushed 10 feet directly away. Critical Failure The creature is pushed 15 feet directly away and falls prone. This is forced movement.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.BoundingReposit: The creature Leaps up to 15 feet horizontally or 5 feet vertically. This special Leap doesn't trigger reactions that are triggered by movement. The creature must end this movement in a space it could normally occupy.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.PredatorsExchan: Trigger An ally adjacent to an enemy both hunters threaten moves out of a space adjacent to that enemy. The creature Steps into the ally's vacated space. If this causes the creature to flank that enemy, the creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus to its next melee attack roll against that enemy before the end of its next turn.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.CrushingGrip.De: Requirement The creature has the target grabbed or restrained. The creature attempts an Athletics check against the target's Fortitude DC. On a success, the target is enfeebled 1 until the end of the creature's next turn. On a critical failure, the creature loses its hold and the target is no longer grabbed or restrained by this creature.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.FinishTheHunt.D: Frequency once per round. Requirement A creature at or below half its maximum Hit Points is within melee reach. The creature makes a melee Strike against that target. On a hit, the Strike deals one additional damage die of the same type and size as its primary damage die.
Trigger An enemy within melee reach critically fails a Strike against the creature. The creature chooses one of the following options: Step up to 10 feet, or make a melee Strike against the triggering enemy. If it Steps, the movement has the normal benefits of Step and doesn't trigger reactions based on movement.
PF2E_CF_PREDATOR.Ability.ApexInstinct.De: When the creature rolls Perception or Stealth for initiative, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to that initiative check. If the creature acts before at least one enemy, the first enemy it targets with a melee Strike before the end of its first turn is off-guard to that Strike. These benefits apply only when the encounter begins.
